The numerator and denominator are $u(x)=-2$ and $v(x)=4x-9,$ respectively. Their derivatives are given by

 

$$
\begin{aligned}{u}^{′}(x) & =0, \\ {v}^{′}(x) & =4.\end{aligned}
$$

Applying the quotient rule, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{{u}^{′}(x)\cdot v(x)-u(x){v}^{′}(x)}{[v(x)]^{2}} \\  & =\frac{(0)\cdot (4x-9)-(-2)\cdot (4)}{{(4x-9)}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{8}{{(4x-9)}^{2}}.\end{aligned}
$$
